title: Newly Established Bar Equity Stake For Sale in Naxxar, Malta
tagline: Pre-revenue, concept-driven catering and entertainment venture in Malta aiming to offer gourmet fast food, themed dining, bars, clubs, and live entertainment experiences. - The concept includes a 1950s-style American diner, themed bars and clubs, and fine-dining-style experiences. - The proposed offering can include American classics such as burgers, hot dogs, pizzas, steaks, and desserts, supported by a full bar. - Entertainment is planned around live bands, open-stage performances, and live sports screenings for local customers and tourists. - The venture is promoter-led and backed by more than 40 years of experience in creating and operating hospitality and entertainment venues. - The promoter's previous portfolio includes discotheques, rock and salsa bars, pubs, restaurants, and entertainment venues, along with radio, concerts, tribute shows, and large-scale events. - Several previous venues operated successfully for more than 10 years, providing an established track record in hospitality operations, marketing, and event promotion. - The promoter also has experience in operating a radio station, organizing high-profile concerts and events, and commercializing a fire-retardant compound. - The current venture is a new business idea, with unique catering and entertainment concepts prepared and ready for launch. - A bar license and music license will be acquired when operations commence.
